note: 161 probes. Two green->red regressions appeared on the first run and both are resolved. oh-config-surfaces was a REAL red caused by this branch, but the probe was wrong, not the code: it grepped CLI sources for homedir() and allowlisted two files by path, while its own desc names the invariant as 'resolves config out of $HOME'. commands/langfuse.ts reads every authored setting from the repository root and calls homedir() once, as a write destination. Rather than allowlist the file — which would have made the probe green without making it true, and handed every later file the same free pass — the probe was rewritten to test the property, and an injection proves that adding a file to the owner list still FAILS unless that file carries the OH_HOME/AGRO_HOME relocation contract. It also gained coverage the old grep lacked: process.env.HOME and env.HOME. spec-task-artifact-contract was the pipeline mid-flight, waiting on this file and simplicity-review.json. The two remaining reds are pre-existing, carry an unchanged delta, and are not caused by this branch: next-dev-prod is a stray `next dev` server in an unrelated project worktree, and skills-vendored concerns Hermes' separate runtime home.
